text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The start of summer camp has finally
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since we last came
here...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, not yet. Let me put away my bags,
then we
can jump straight into training.
choice_data_list: 景気づけに何か食べるか？
景気づけに何か食べる？
choice_data_list_en: Want to grab a bite to pump ourselves up?
Want to grab a bite to pump ourselves up?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Both my rivals, Creek and Tama, are
waiting for
me... I need to get stronger
so I can go toe-to-toe
with them.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let's save the eating for when we're
done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, our summer camp is off to a
heated
start.
